verdict.rationale: Meilisearch is documented as a dependency-free single binary that runs headlessly as an API server. It can be installed via a cURL one-liner or official Docker images and run on any OS, which supports scripted automation. Community reports confirm containerized and k8s deployments that 'just worked'. However, no evidence explicitly documents CI pipeline usage. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs (e.g., service-container or GitHub Actions guidance), documented non-interactive configuration for ephemeral test runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Meilisearch is a single binary with no external dependencies. You can run it on any Linux, macOS, or Windows machine, on bare metal or in containers.
Official Meilisearch Docker images for easy deployment and development.
exposes them through fast full-text search, semantic search, and conversational interfaces, all from a single API
